summary: Iteration 11 — QR-sticker per appartement for Tenant Kiosk. Backend: 9 NEW pytest cases in test_kiosk_qr_sticker.py — all PASS. Covers (a) GET /api/tenant-portal/lookup-apartment/{id} public happy-path with PII-leak guard (no pin_hash, no phone), 404 for unknown apt, 404 for apt without tenant/PIN, works without Authorization header; (b) GET /api/apartments/{id}/kiosk-sticker.pdf returns application/pdf + %PDF magic, public (no auth), 404 unknown apt, no crash for apartments without tenant; (c) end-to-end lookup→login chain. Regression: existing test_tenant_kiosk.py 15/16 PASS + 1 SKIP (no open invoice — environmental, not a regression). Frontend smoke tests: /kiosk/huurder?apt=<valid> shows 'Welkom Bharat' + 'Appartement HUIS 7K' (tk-prefill-apt), zero tk-email-input, PIN pad visible, entering 5678 → tk-dashboard appears. /kiosk/huurder?apt=<invalid> gracefully falls back to email step (no crash). /kiosk/huurder (no query) shows email step as before. Admin UI Appartementen tab: 4 apt-qr-<id> anchors found, each href correctly points to /api/apartments/<id>/kiosk-sticker.pdf with target=_blank.

issues: Pre-existing from iter 10: negative balance (SRD -271.836,60) still rendered with GREEN 'U bent volledig bij. Bedankt!' styling — confusing. Consider clamping to 0 or showing 'Tegoed'.

critical_code_review_comments: lookup-apartment correctly projects out pin_hash via Mongo projection but also includes phone in the projection (still excluded from the response dict) — defence-in-depth OK. Response strictly returns name/email/first_name, no leakage verified by test.

lookup-apartment returns 404 with Dutch detail 'Geen huurder met PIN op dit appartement' when tenant missing OR pin missing — same code path. Acceptable for kiosk UX (frontend falls back to email step).
kiosk-sticker.pdf endpoint correctly degrades when apartment has no tenant (tenant_name=None) — verified PDF generated successfully (PASS test_pdf_does_not_crash_for_apartment_without_tenant).

Both new endpoints are PUBLIC by design (no get_current_user dependency). apartment_id acts as the access token. PDF returns only physically-visible info (apt number, tenant name, address) which is already on the front door — privacy model is sound.
AdminDashboard.jsx QR anchor uses process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL directly — correct usage of env var, no hardcoded URL.

TenantKioskLayout.jsx prefill flow uses useEffect to sync step→'pin' when prefill arrives async after lookup. data-testid='tk-prefill-apt' present only when titleSub truthy — good (regression test passes).
server.py still 5299 lines — pre-existing concern noted in iter 10. New endpoints add ~70 lines around 2914-2982. Recommend extracting tenant-portal routes when convenient.
pdf_gen.kiosk_sticker_pdf invoked via dynamic `from pdf_gen import kiosk_sticker_pdf` inside endpoint — works but a module-level import would be cleaner / slightly faster.
